meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: Spatial statements, including RRBs, March 2004 to March 2017
meta.coverage: Commercial banks at a glance (statement 1): banks and offices, growth of deposits and credit by bank group and population group, and the credit-deposit ratio, every quarter from March 2004 to March 2017, including regional rural banks
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1481 (data provider DP8), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published.
